en.name: Sets special rules for calculating insurance premiums for FY2026
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Long-Term Care Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: Following a partial amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Long-Term Care Insurance Act, special rules will be set for calculating income and other items used to calculate long-term care insurance premium rates for FY2026. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Sets special rules for calculating income and other items used to calculate premium rates for FY2026
who: People who pay long-term care insurance premiums
en.why: The ward says this is because of a partial amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Long-Term Care Insurance Act.
